name: Wolf
soul: The soul of one who is not whole alone, and who has always known who is missing from a room before knowing who is in it.
spark: The mote keeps low and circles your heels; when you run, it is already ahead.

hybrid.text: It runs down what it wants and does not let go.

settled.name: Wolf pup
settled.text: All paws and ears. It follows you everywhere and has not yet learned it is not the same size as what it barks at.
settled.sign: One ear up and one still deciding. Its paws are already the size the rest of it will be.
settled.habit: It sleeps across your boots, so that you cannot leave without its knowing.

paths.name: Counting Wolf
paths.of: one who counts everyone at the door
paths.text: It learned from you that nobody is left on the wrong side of a door. It knows how many you set out with.
paths.sign: Its head moves along a line of people one at a time, and stops on the gap.
paths.habit: It walks the room touching each of your friends once with its nose, then lies down facing the door.

prongs.name: Pack-runner
prongs.of: one who is never the one out of step
prongs.text: It runs where the party runs and is never the one out of place.
prongs.sign: It runs a half-length off your left knee and has never once been trodden on.
prongs.habit: It matches its breathing to whoever in the room is nearest sleep.

finishes.name: Pack-mother
finishes.of: one the others fall in behind without being asked
finishes.text: The others' genii fall in behind it. Nobody told them to.
finishes.sign: Smaller genii walk in its tracks. It does not look back to check.
finishes.habit: It washes the ears of other people's genii, who put up with it.

finishes.name: Line-runner
finishes.of: one who knows the way home from anywhere on the line
finishes.text: It has run every mile of the line you have, and knows the next post before you see its lamp.
finishes.sign: Rail grease on all four feet, and its eyes fixed one post further on than yours.
finishes.habit: It lies with its chin on the rail, feeling for the car.

prongs.name: Hearth-wolf
prongs.of: one who makes a home of wherever the others are
prongs.text: It sleeps across the door of wherever the party sleeps. To leave in the night you must step over it, and it wakes.
prongs.sign: Its coat holds a faint light, like a window seen from the road.
prongs.habit: It turns three times and lies down where it can see every bed.

finishes.name: Den-keeper
finishes.of: one beside whom others can finally sleep
finishes.text: Where it lies down is the safest place in the zone, and the party knows it.
finishes.sign: A lamp-glow rides at its collar. People sit down near it without noticing they have.
finishes.habit: It stays awake until the last of the party is asleep, and only then puts its head down.

finishes.name: Shade-friend
finishes.of: one who still counts those who did not come back
finishes.text: The shades at the hearth speak to it before they speak to you.
finishes.sign: Its eyes are older than the rest of it, and they follow things at the hearth you cannot see.
finishes.habit: At the lamp hour it sits by the empty places at the table, one after another.

prongs.name: Caller
prongs.of: one who calls, and expects to be answered
prongs.text: What it howls at turns to look, and for that moment is not looking at you.
prongs.sign: A pale ring of fur stands up round its head when it lifts its muzzle.
prongs.habit: It howls once at dusk and waits, head tilted, until something answers.

finishes.name: Voice of the Pack
finishes.text: One howl, and every genius in earshot answers.
finishes.sign: A length of chain at its throat rings on the low note.
finishes.habit: It answers every dog on the line, in turn, and expects them to wait for it.

finishes.name: Oath-wolf
finishes.of: one who holds a friend to their word
finishes.text: It was there when you swore, and it holds you to it harder than the Terms do.
finishes.sign: A closed book hangs at its neck. Its eyes go to your hands whenever you promise anything.
finishes.habit: It sits facing you with its head level and does not blink first.

paths.name: Third-day Wolf
paths.of: one who cannot let a thing go
paths.text: It learned from you that a thing is not over because it got away. On the third day it is still on the trail.
paths.sign: Lean in the flank and long in the leg, with its nose a hand above the ground even indoors.
paths.habit: It goes back to the last place it lost a scent and stands there a while.

prongs.name: Long-strider
prongs.of: one who goes further out than anyone asked
prongs.text: It ranges out to where your shots land and holds what you hit until you come.
prongs.sign: One ear is always turned behind it, toward you, however far ahead it is.
prongs.habit: It walks to the edge of earshot, sits, and looks back to see if you are coming.

finishes.name: Name-hunter
finishes.of: one who remembers everything that got away
finishes.text: It remembers every named beast that got away, and so does its nose.
finishes.sign: Grey at the muzzle, with a nose that works in its sleep.
finishes.habit: It dreams with its legs running, and wakes facing the same way each time.

finishes.name: Far Courser
finishes.of: one who is already where the trouble will be
finishes.text: A grey line at the edge of your sight that is always where the foe is about to be.
finishes.sign: Two long flags of grey fur stream from its shoulders at the run, like wings.
finishes.habit: It watches the horizon rather than the room.

prongs.name: Throat-taker
prongs.of: one who waits for the word and then does not hesitate
prongs.text: It waits for your Pattern the way a dog waits for a thrown stick.
prongs.sign: Its jaw hangs a little open, and it watches your hands, not your face.
prongs.habit: It lies coiled with its eyes on you, and is up when you draw breath to speak.

finishes.name: Red Maw
finishes.of: one who stops being careful when a friend is hurt
finishes.text: When you are hurt it stops being careful.
finishes.sign: A red light at the back of its throat that brightens when you bleed.
finishes.habit: It licks old wounds: yours first, then its own.

finishes.name: Quiet Tooth
finishes.of: one who settles a thing and tells nobody
finishes.text: You do not hear it go. You hear what it went for.
finishes.sign: Its outline is hard to keep hold of in poor light. Its feet make no sound on gravel.
finishes.habit: It leaves the room and comes back. You only notice the second part.

prongs.name: Grey Shield
prongs.of: one who would sooner be hit than give up a yard
prongs.text: It takes the blow you did not see, and then the one you did.
prongs.sign: The fur over its shoulders has gone grey and hard as slate.
prongs.habit: It leans its whole weight against your leg, and does not shift when you do.

finishes.name: Wall-wolf
finishes.of: one who has never taken a step back
finishes.text: It does not move back. Things that hit it learn something about walls.
finishes.sign: Flat plates across the chest and brow. It stands square, like a thing built there.
finishes.habit: It picks the narrowest place in any room and lies across it.

finishes.name: Scar-bearer
finishes.of: one who carries every hurt forward and hides none
finishes.text: Every blow you took is on its coat as well. It wears them forward.
finishes.sign: Its coat is a map of healed lines, each one matching a scar of yours.
finishes.habit: It lies with its scarred side to the fire.

paths.name: Night-watch
paths.of: one who cannot sleep while the others do
paths.text: It sleeps in the day now, because you do not sleep at night.
paths.sign: Dark all round the eyes, as if it had not slept, which it has not.
paths.habit: It walks the edge of the lamplight all night and sleeps in the first sun.

prongs.name: Perimeter Wolf
prongs.of: one who walks the bounds so that others need not think of them
prongs.text: It walks the edge of whatever light you have, all night, at one pace. The dark has learned where the edge is.
prongs.sign: A path is worn in a ring round wherever you camp. It is on it.
prongs.habit: It paces the same circuit until dawn and steps in its own prints.

finishes.name: Post-wolf
finishes.of: one who stays at the post until relieved
finishes.text: A post it has lain beside stays lit a little longer than it should.
finishes.sign: A small lamp burns at its collar and does not gutter in wind.
finishes.habit: It lies under the post lamp with its head up, facing down the line.

finishes.name: Lamp-eyed Wolf
finishes.of: one who sees what is coming before the others wake
finishes.text: Its eyes show you what is winding up in the dark before the dark does.
finishes.sign: Its eyes give back the lamp from much further off than they should.
finishes.habit: It stares at one patch of dark for a long time. It is usually right to.

prongs.name: Moon-reader
prongs.of: one who feels a bad night coming
prongs.text: It lifts its head a breath before the strike comes. Watch its ears, not the foe.
prongs.sign: Its ears lift a breath before anything happens.
prongs.habit: It sits with its face to the sky and its ears moving, long after you have stopped listening.

finishes.name: Omen-wolf
finishes.of: one who knows a bad day by its morning
finishes.text: It howls once on the morning of a bad day. It has not been wrong.
finishes.sign: A third eye-mark, pale, in the fur of its brow.
finishes.habit: Some mornings it is at the door before you, and will not move from it.

finishes.name: Still Wolf
finishes.of: one who can be alone without being lonely
finishes.text: It can sit so quiet beside you that the field itself goes quiet round it.
finishes.sign: No breath shows from it in the cold. The air round it is very quiet.
finishes.habit: It sits so still that birds have landed on it.

prongs.name: Storm-coat
prongs.of: one who is out in all weathers and does not mention it
prongs.text: Your element has got into its fur, and it shakes it off over whatever you point at.
prongs.sign: Its fur smokes faintly with your weather: steam, or frost, or sparks.
prongs.habit: It shakes itself in doorways, and the room gets some of the weather.

finishes.name: Frost-ruff
finishes.of: one who takes the cold watch and keeps it
finishes.text: Where it has run, the ground remembers winter.
finishes.sign: White rime stands on its ruff and does not melt indoors.
finishes.habit: It sleeps outside the door, on the stone, by choice.

finishes.name: Ember-ruff
finishes.of: one who comes in from the dark still warm
finishes.text: Its ruff is banked coals. It lies down at the hearth and the hearth burns higher.
finishes.sign: Its ruff glows dull red from underneath, like coals under ash.
finishes.habit: It lies by the hearth and the fire leans toward it.
